hero.title:
PABLO
GOZÁLVEZ
hero.subtitle: I'm Pablo Gozálvez, a software developer from Alicante. I mainly work with Java and Spring, and my own projects also include web applications, tools and games.

preview.summary: I currently work at Accenture on Java and Spring applications, APIs and databases. Outside work, I keep building my own projects, from mobile apps to Unity games.

projectDescriptions.outreal: A mobile app for finding things to do and meeting people nearby, with a map, proximity alerts and a user trust system.
projectDescriptions.hospitalXyz: A 3D tour to explore the route to radiodiagnosis at Hospital Dr. Balmis before a visit.
projectDescriptions.trickyMansion: A 2D platformer with random levels, made with Unity and released on Google Play and itch.io.
projectDescriptions.pseudoBlocks: A block-based programming environment in C# and WinForms, with its own lexer and parser.

about.title: About me
about.p1: I started making programs on my own and ended up doing this for a living. I like understanding how things work and having room to try out ideas, whether in an application, a tool or a game.
about.p2: I now work at Accenture, developing and maintaining Java and Spring applications. My day-to-day work includes REST and SOAP APIs, reviewing SQL queries and fixing production issues. I'm also taking a specialization course in Artificial Intelligence and Big Data.
about.trackRecord: I always seem to have a project on the go. Here are a few of them: applications, tools and games I've worked on.

projects.title: Projects
projects.subtitle: Some of the applications, tools and games I've worked on. You can try them, browse the code or see how they were built.

outreal.description: A mobile app for finding things to do and meeting people nearby. It includes a map, proximity alerts and a user trust system.

hospitalXyz.title: Virtual hospital navigation tours
hospitalXyz.description: A 3D hospital tour that lets patients explore the route to radiodiagnosis before their visit. A collaborative project by Hospital Dr. Balmis, CIPFP Canastell and IES San Vicente.

trickyMansion.description: A 2D platformer with randomly generated levels, enemies and traps. Developed with Unity and released on Google Play and itch.io.

pseudoBlocks.description: A block-based programming environment made with C# and WinForms. It includes its own lexer and parser to interpret instructions.

clumsyMimics.description: A game developed in 48 hours for a game jam, where it won an award.

scrollCarousel.description: A component for creating carousels with scrolling and inertia in Unity interfaces. It is published on the Asset Store, with source code available on GitHub.

superMarioPhaser.description: A browser-based recreation of Super Mario, made with Phaser and JavaScript. It includes platforming physics and level generation.

jokerAssistant.description: A desktop assistant that recognizes voice commands and performs actions using Microsoft Speech API. Developed with C# and WinForms.
